_comment: The Assize Quarter of Veyr (M5). Who stands where, what can be read, where a Witness may rest. The stone itself is built in gameplay/world/quarter.gd; positions here are metres in that space, [x, y, z], +Z north. Floors: market 0, landing 4, forecourt and Hall 8, Docket -4.
name: The Assize Quarter

records.title: Notice of the Meridian Court
records.text:
By order of the Court. The Oath Hall on the west side of the market is closed for repair.

No vow was broken there. A vow spoken before a witness in Veyr cannot break.

Persons saying otherwise will be asked who witnessed it.

records.title: Chalked on the fallen stone
records.text:
It broke. I heard it. Eleven of us heard it.

They have asked each of us who the witness was, and each of us has said: not me.

Somebody was. M.T.

records.title: An oath-broker's slate
records.text:
Vows witnessed today: none.
Yesterday: forty-one.

Nobody will swear to anything until somebody says what happened in the Hall. Rent is due regardless.

records.title: A copyist's working sheet
records.text:
Canon, leaf twelve, copied fair for the Arbiter. Twelve Roots, as always.

I have ruled thirteen lines, because the exemplar is ruled with thirteen. I do not know why the exemplar has thirteen lines.

I have left the last one blank, as it is. T.H.

records.title: A child's question, answered in a clerk's hand
records.text:
Q. What holds the Courts up?
A. The chains.

Q. What holds the chains?
A. That is not a question for the Stair.

records.title: A docket, water-damaged
records.text:
Contract of service. Parties: the ink has run.
Witness: one, sworn. Term: until kept.

One line is struck through.

The strike is in fresher ink than the water.

records.title: A Bailiff's standing order
records.text:
Wards are taken through the Docket under Escort, in pairs. While the two of you stand together nothing can bar your way.

If you are parted, the Escort lapses.

Do not let them part you.

records.title: Carved beside the portal
records.text:
STANDING IS GRANTED, NOT TAKEN.
THE ARBITER SAYS EACH RULE BEFORE HE ENFORCES IT.
HE IS BOUND BY WHAT HE SPEAKS.

Scratched underneath, small: so make him speak.

gates.name: The Docket Gate
gates.locked: It does not open from this side.
